review.summary: Strong post-publication governance work. The published 0.2.4 payload is held byte-immutable via Git blob-OID comparison against commit 6f18529 with an explicit governance allowlist; the composed guard executes the original delivery guard in the retained qualified checkout and binds its receipt; fresh tag/CI observations come from a hash-registered producer with two-snapshot confirmation, an observation window, and preserved run-30 failure. All four delivery receipts verify, including a credential-free re-download of the public registry archive. Prior attempt-1/2 findings are implemented. Blocking defect: the new governance CI route's receipt-log step reads report keys the portable report never emits, so that job fails and no test covers it. Lesser gaps: unbound executable tooling under fingerprint-excluded docs/reviews, and AGENTS.md still naming a single push destination.

findings.description: The governance contracts job logs report["phase"] and report["source_unchanged"], but the portable governance report written by postdelivery.qualify_portable/verify_portable contains only passed, source_sha256, qualifiedSourceSha256, scope, registryArchiveSha256, limitation, checks and hostQualificationSha256 (confirmed in docs/checks/phase-28-postdelivery-contracts.json:1-8). The step raises KeyError, so the contracts-and-package job of the documented governance CI route (docs/post-publication-governance.md:66-70, docs/CI.md:169) always fails. No test exercises the logged key set; test_ci.py:161-175 checks only flag admission.
findings.required_fix: Add "phase": 28 and "source_unchanged": True to the portable report in tools/postdelivery.py (verify_portable/qualify_portable) rather than editing the workflow key list, because immutable_inventory (tools/postdelivery.py:70-77) only permits the two exact command/report-name substitutions in ci.yml; then add a test asserting the workflow-extracted key set is present in the portable report.

findings.description: Executable, token-reading, network-capable tooling is stored under docs/reviews/, which review_phase.EXCLUDED_DIRECTORIES (tools/review_phase.py:15) removes from the source fingerprint and postdelivery.excluded (tools/postdelivery.py:46) removes from the immutable payload inventory. Its only hash record is the self-contained unit-checks.json in the same unbound directory, and phase-status release_preflight.ci_observation_producer references it in prose without a digest, so it can be modified without changing any reviewed source identity or failing any gate.
findings.required_fix: Bind the retained producer and its unit-check receipt by SHA-256 in docs/phase-status.json release_preflight.ci_observation_producer and in the governance report's immutableEvidence map, or relocate the retained tool to a fingerprinted path explicitly marked historical.

findings.description: The top-level contract still states a single authorized push destination (Forgejo SSH) while delivery now requires a GitHub mirror annotated-tag push (docs/PHASES.md:306-312, docs/typescript-035-parity-plan.md:160-166). AGENTS.md is deliberately outside GOVERNANCE_PATHS to keep the published payload immutable, so the inconsistency cannot be fixed in this chunk, but phase-status does not carry it as an explicit open deficiency for this chunk.
findings.required_fix: Record the unsynchronized AGENTS.md mirror clause as an explicit carried deficiency in the phase-28 review_findings_disposition, and schedule the AGENTS.md update for the next payload-changing phase.

findings.description: test_postdelivery.py and test_final_delivery_review.py are skipped by the glob discovery used for commands_for(27) and the derived phase-28 set, preserving the 105-command count but leaving them outside every cumulative phase gate; they run only in the 7-suite governance route (tools/postdelivery.py:254-256). docs/CI.md's command inventory does not state this exclusion.
findings.required_fix: Document the deliberate exclusion in docs/CI.md's gate-command section and add the two suites to the cumulative command set of the next phase that may change source.

evidence: docs/reviews/phase-28-chunk-remote-delivery-attempt-03.checks.json: 8 commands, all exit_code 0, scope post_publication_governance, source_sha256 2a2984e3… matching the reviewed source; recorded unittest tails total 17+6+14+52+12+17+38 = 156 tests, matching phase-status post_publication_governance.focused_tests=156 and qualification_commands=8.

Independently re-derived delivery binding: docs/checks/phase-28-postdelivery-contracts.json:6 registryArchiveSha256 533294fe977e26e251e01dd2de64a896aa22ce45e97ac6264a0df6af879edd55 equals docs/checks/release-registry-0.2.4.json:12 archiveSha256, fetched by tools/postdelivery.py:339-348 with no-redirect opener, 32 MiB bound and byte/length comparison.

docs/checks/release-tag-v0.2.4-observation-03.json and docs/checks/release-tag-github-v0.2.4-observation-03.json both record tagObject 2f7ad298abb9d8e41b7b7c40552e8924994b3d3e peeled to 6f18529a… on their respective remotes, with producer scripts/observe-release.py and observerSha256 a1c1383c…; tools/postdelivery.py:101-132 requires remote identity, equal tag objects, matching original receipts, current observer hash and observation-after-publication timing.

docs/checks/phase-28-remote-ci-run-31-observation-03.json: 49/49 contexts success (counts line 2668-2670, expectedJobCount 49), statusSelection max(created_at,id), snapshot retains earlier pending rows for the same contexts so the tie-breaker is actually exercised, runHistory preserves run 30 failure and run 31 success on 56a88d25…, and snapshot/runHistory digests equal the confirmation block captured in a 2.3 s window (lines 1159-1161, 2299-2314).

tools/postdelivery.py:53-91 immutable_inventory reconstructs Git blob OIDs and file modes for every tracked/untracked non-evidence path against commit 6f18529a…, rejecting any symmetric-difference outside GOVERNANCE_PATHS; tools/test_postdelivery.py:58-107 proves rejection of changed Rust/contract/lockfile/README bytes, a new payload file, a payload symlink and a non-allowlisted new tool.

tools/postdelivery.py:135-147 verify_retained_guard binds docs/checks/phase-28-composed-delivery-F.json to the actual re-executed guard (command, cwd, exit code, parsed result, stdout/stderr digests); tools/test_postdelivery.py:377-398 rejects tampering in all seven fields. The attempt-03 canonicalGuard records exit_code 0 with jobs 49, sourceCommit 6f18529a…, ciCommit 56a88d25….

tools/release_delivery.py:121-126 verify_source_commits recomputes commit_fingerprint for both the published and CI commits, requires both to equal the reviewed source and enforces ancestry, which is what legitimises CI on 56a88d25… for the payload published from 6f18529a….

tools/review_phase.py:62-94 and 251-265 bind the separate final-delivery budget to the exact maintainer grant in docs/reviews/recovery-authorizations/2026-10-22.json (questionCallId call_1601a73a…, answer text, maxFreshReviews 5) and to a pinned digest over all 20 original readiness artifacts; tools/test_final_delivery_review.py (6 tests) covers cross-phase/chunk misuse and grant/original tampering.

docs/CI.md:377-395 and docs/post-publication-governance.md:89-101 state the run-30 failure, the six-second reproduction, that run 31 does not establish a root cause or shipped test fix, that Pages deployment and directional live acceptance remain unverified, and that phases 24/25 are not completed by this publication.
limitations: Read-only review: no commands, tests or network calls were executed. Check outcomes were assessed from the recorded stdout/stderr in docs/reviews/phase-28-chunk-remote-delivery-attempt-03.checks.json and docs/checks/phase-28-postdelivery.json (identical bytes, SHA-256 5c1439b4…, cross-referenced by hostQualificationSha256).

The retained qualified checkout /home/cdot/development/cdot65/scm-sdk-rs-ts035 is outside this repository and was not inspected, so the 105-command report, both compiler package proofs, the retained archives and the canonical guard execution are accepted as recorded by the composed guard rather than independently re-derived.

Remote state (Forgejo refs/CI, GitHub mirror refs, crates.io bytes) was not contacted; tag, CI and registry claims rest on point-in-time receipts, which the design itself documents as non-atomic observations.

The ci.yml receipt-step defect was established statically from the key list in the workflow versus the keys emitted by verify_portable/qualify_portable and present in the on-disk report; the failing CI job itself was not run.

Git history, diffs and the published ci.yml bytes could not be read directly; the conclusion that the workflow differs from the published file only by the two allowed substitutions follows from the successful immutable_inventory execution in the recorded composed-guard run.
